authorization: User requests concurrency x2, then explicitly directs full production without spending time on tests; preserve logs and checkpoints. No hash or synthetic acceptance gates.
unchanged: Model/revision/BF16, prompts, native agents, context65536, per-call output8192, seeds, per-trial CPU/RAM/time, task denominators and scoring.
activation: Health readiness only, followed directly by full formal cohorts; no synthetic or extra acceptance requests. Old live services/controllers are not interrupted.

initial_production.scope: 43 never-generated tasks, including seven zero-generation setup failures and two images still downloading. Eight already-generated tasks are retained. Fixed51 denominator.
initial_production.handoff: Run full available scope on the existing endpoint immediately; when the new service is healthy, stop new admission, finish all active trials naturally, then continue pending IDs on the new endpoint. Never interrupt trials to change concurrency.

measurement: Observe actual formal run logs, request latency, queue depth and progress checkpoints. Do not run a separate throughput test or assume2x speedup.
disclosure: Concurrency profiles can affect queue time within fixed task budgets; record profile with each cohort and disclose the change in the final baseline.

terminal_production.scope: Only pending and explicitly authorized infrastructure-incomplete trials; completed answers retained
terminal_production.handoff: Old runtime6 halted with no active solver or model request; owner fences new admission until the new endpoint is healthy.
